# Getting help

| For | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Questions, bugs and feature requests | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/PILOTAAI/slotlock/issues). Issues are public: never paste an API key, a token or anyone's personal data. |
| Hosted Slotlock: your account, keys and limits | [support@pylota.io](mailto:support@pylota.io) |
| Hosted Slotlock: is it up? | Open issues labelled [`status`](https://github.com/PILOTAAI/slotlock/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Astatus%20is%3Aopen) ([how they are raised](../docs/hosted/status.md)) |
| Abuse of hosted Slotlock | [abuse@pylota.io](mailto:abuse@pylota.io), as the [Acceptable Use Policy](../ACCEPTABLE-USE.md) describes |
| Your personal data, or erasing an account | [privacy@pylota.io](mailto:privacy@pylota.io), as the [privacy notice](../PRIVACY.md) describes |
| A security vulnerability | Privately, through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/PILOTAAI/slotlock/security/advisories/new), as [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) describes. Never in an issue. |
| A code of conduct concern | The contact in [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#reporting) |

Hosted Slotlock is free and best effort, with no service level agreement
([Terms of Service](../TERMS.md)). For Slotlock you run yourself, the README's
[production checklist](../README.md#production-checklist) and [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) come first.
